units.source_text: 那房间的格子窗本来是开着的。

en.t: The lattice window of that room had originally been open.

units.source_text: 纪伊守嫌她们不恭敬，教关上了。

en.t: The Governor of Kii thought the women were being disrespectful, so he had it closed.

units.source_text: 室内点灯，女人们的影子映出在纸隔扇[\[25\]](#part1331.html#m25)上。

en.t: Lamps were lit inside, and the women's shadows were cast on the paper sliding screens[\[25\]](#part1331.html#m25).

units.source_text: 源氏公子走近去，想窥看室内，但纸隔扇都无隙缝，

en.t: Prince Genji went closer and tried to peer inside, but there was not even a crack in the paper screens,
so he could only strain his ears and listen.

units.source_text: 但听见她们都已集中在靠近这边的正屋里，窃窃私语。

en.t: He heard that they had all gathered in the main room near his side and were whispering together.

units.source_text: 仔细一听，正是在谈论他。

en.t: When he listened closely, they were talking about him.

units.source_text: 有一人说：“真是一位尊严的公子啊！

en.t: One of them said, "What a truly dignified prince he is!

units.source_text: 早就娶定了一位不称心的夫人，也真可惜。

en.t: It is such a pity that he was promised so early to a lady who does not suit his heart.

units.source_text: 但是听说他有心爱的情人，常常偷偷地往来。”

en.t: But I hear he has a beloved mistress and often visits her in secret."

units.source_text: 公子听了这话，想起了自己的心事，不免担忧。

en.t: When the prince heard this, he remembered his own private concerns and could not help feeling anxious.

units.source_text: 他想：“她们在这种谈话的场合，说不定会把我和藤壶妃子的事情泄漏出来，

en.t: He thought, "In a conversation like this, they might let slip the matter between me and Lady Fujitsubo,

units.source_text: 教我自己听到了，如何是好呢？”

en.t: and if I were to hear it myself, what would I do?"
